about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Range Rover P510e ENGINE
paragraphs: The Range Rover P510e is part of the current-generation L460 range, introduced in 2022. It uses the AJ300P — a 3.0-litre inline-six petrol engine developed by Jaguar Land Rover as part of the Ingenium engine family. What makes the P510e distinct within the Range Rover line-up is its plug-in hybrid system: the AJ300P is paired with a 105kW electric motor, and the badge tracks the combined power output. The same underlying engine family appears across all four PHEV badges in the current Range Rover range — P440e, P460e, P510e and P550e — with different combined power outputs calibrated for each tier. Range Rover P510e Engine Compatibility Because the P510e uses a specific Ingenium AJ300P engine with a plug-in hybrid system, not every Range Rover engine is a straight fit. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm: - Your exact engine code (AJ300P) via registration or VIN - Your generation (L460) - Hybrid system compatibility - Drivetrain and ancillary specification - Any electronics or ECU considerations specific to your exact build This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic Range Rover quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car. The Range Rover P510e uses the AJ300P — a 3.0-litre inline-six petrol engine with a 105kW electric motor as part of the plug-in hybrid system. It's the same engine family that appears across the P440e, P460e, P510e and P550e badges, with different combined power outputs depending on the tier. How much does a Range Rover P510e engine rebuild cost? Rebuilds start from £3,200. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote. Do you rebuild AJ300P Range Rover P510e engines? Yes. We replace timing chains, bearings and gaskets as standard on every AJ300P rebuild, and fully service the engine ancillaries. Do you supply used Range Rover P510e engines? Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation. Can you recover my Range Rover P510e if the engine has failed? Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking. How long does a Range Rover P510e engine rebuild take? Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop. Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine? For most Range Rover P510e owners, yes. codes.titlePre: Land Rover Range Rover P510e ENGINE

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the Range Rover P510e from 2023 to present. The engine features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older engine V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every engine rebuild.
